artifacts.summary: Plan v6: Enrich the Until/Since formula in KampBypass.lean to encode full 2-var NF (including between-zone content) and delete false PriorComposition.lean theorems. 4 phases, 14 hours estimated.

memory_candidates.content: The non-constant-env composition theorem (depth-(K+2) 1-var agreement + matching orders + Prior-UZ/SZ => depth-(K+2) 2-var agreement) is FALSE on Prior structures. Counterexample: M=N=(Z,<,P_everywhere) with envM=[2,0], envN=[1,0]. Interval (0,2) contains integer 1 while (0,1) is empty, creating different 2-var NFs despite identical 1-var NFs. This falsifies PriorComposition.lean theorems and all plans (v2-v5) that attempted to prove this statement.
